title: Understanding Agentic AI
overview: This presentation demystifies Agentic AI, distinguishes it from Generative AI, and explores its core components, applications, and practical implementation.
summary: This presentation demystifies Agentic AI, distinguishes it from Generative AI, and explores its core components, applications, and practical implementation.

slides.title: What is Agentic AI?
slides.content:
Not a complex subject, easily understood.
Focuses on the agent's "what" and "how."
Enables AI to take actions autonomously.
Differs significantly from traditional generative AI.
Goes beyond simple input-output functions.
Requires a structured thought process for effectiveness.

slides.title: Generative AI Explained
slides.content:
Centered around Large Language Models (LLMs) as the "brain."
Dependent solely on user input for output generation.
Acts as a single brain with thinking capability.
Lacks the ability to take external actions.
Essentially a fancy next-word prediction mechanism.
Generates comprehensive answers or code based on prompts.

slides.title: Generative vs. Agentic AI [COMPARISON]
slides.content:
Generative AI: Input-output based
Generative AI: No external actions
Generative AI: Next-word prediction
Agentic AI: Goal-driven actions
Agentic AI: Can interact with tools
Agentic AI: Includes planning, memory, reasoning

slides.title: Agentic AI Key Elements
slides.content:
**Goal:** User-defined objective for the agent.
**Planning:** Breaking down goals into actionable steps.
**Memory:** Retains context from past interactions or tasks.
**Reasoning:** LLM-powered engine for decision-making.
**Autonomy (Tools):** Executes actions via external functions.
**Reflection:** Evaluates actions and adjusts strategy.

slides.title: Real-World Use Cases
slides.content:
**AI Recruiter:** Scans resumes, emails candidates, schedules interviews.
**Customer Support:** Handles tickets, categorizes, learns from interactions.
**Podcast Planner:** Researches guests, creates notes, suggests questions.
Agents can achieve specific tasks without all components.
LLMs provide the brain, agents perform the task.
Simplifies complex multi-step processes for users.

slides.title: Popular AI Agent Frameworks
slides.content:
**Langgraph:** A widely used framework for building agents.
**Crew AI:** A newer, fantastic option gaining traction.
**AutoGen:** Another popular and emerging framework.
Frameworks simplify agent development significantly.
Langgraph is a good starting point for beginners.
Allows migration to other tools as needs evolve.

slides.title: Building a Task Classifier
slides.content:
Goal: Categorize tasks into high, medium, low priority.
Uses OpenAI (or Gemini/Anthropic) as the LLM "brain."
Reads tasks from a simple text file.
Python script makes API calls with a defined prompt.
Demonstrates agent's ability to classify autonomously.
Shows how simple agents perform specific, focused tasks.

slides.title: Agentic AI: Practical Insights
slides.content:
Agentic AI is not overly complex or magical.
Focuses on structured thought processes and actions.
Combines LLMs with planning, memory, and tools.
Provides practical solutions for automation and problem-solving.
Even simple implementations can qualify as agents.
Empowers AI to move beyond basic responses.
